summary: Artelo Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to terminate its at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with R.F. Lafferty Co., effective May 18, 2026. The ATM program, initiated July 18, 2025, allowed sales of up to $6.5 million of common stock; only 50,858 shares were sold for gross proceeds of ~$452,000. The supplement merely reports the termination and end of the continuous offering, with no change in control, tender, or strategic event. This is a routine disclosure of a financing facility termination, not a special situation.
